scope: Independent, source-only review of the prepared EXT-D-0045 patch and pending component regression. Patch was not applied; no tests, browser, build, or product edits were performed. The installed 0.2.108 artifact predates D45.

findings.evidence: The patch snapshots the active config into stagedConfig on picker entry. ITEM_DETECTED updates only stagedConfig, so choosing scope B does not replace committed scope A or clear its extraction rows. While picking, displayRows hides the prior preview so A's rows are not presented as B output. closePickerSession clears stagedConfig; the result handler snapshots stagedConfigRef before closing and commits it only for a valid matching picker result. A valid Done result for B with zero field_paths therefore commits B, while Cancel/EXIT drops B and returns to committed A and its retained rows.

The result merge uses stagedConfig as its base when its root/item selectors match the Done payload and appends payload.field_paths. Same-scope Done therefore retains staged fields and appends picked fields; a different explicit scope uses the payload config, including an empty field list. Existing fromOurPick tab/session/page checks remain in place, and navigation still closes the picker and invalidates extraction state.

The pending D45 test has two cases: changed-scope Cancel preserving A+field+preview, and changed-scope Done committing B with zero fields. It does not assert same-scope Done appends newly picked fields to existing/staged fields, nor that a late or wrong-session/page result cannot commit staged B. Those are named in the defect's red-guard plan and should be added before this guard is treated as complete.

limitations: This is a review of an unapplied patch, not a test result or installed-extension verification.
The current source still has the pre-D45 behavior; the prepared regression is intentionally undiscoverable with its .pending suffix.
No runtime conclusion is made about React effect ordering or the content-script picker event sequence.
reviewer_note: No confirmed source blocker was found in the requested Cancel/Done transaction paths in the prepared patch. Promote only after the missing same-scope and stale-session assertions are included and the authorized red/green plus installed-extension checks are performed.
